CustomFunction.Text:
Function (CurrencyVar baseValue, CurrencyVar updatedValue)
If baseValue <> 0 Then (updatedValue - baseValue) / baseValue * 100 Else ( If updatedValue = 0 Then 0 Else ( If updatedValue > 0 Then 10^300 //positive infinity Else ( If updatedValue < 0 Then -10^300 //negative infinity ) ) );

CustomFunction.Text:
//' The user supplies a reference date parameter, "d" and a range condition, //' "condition" to indicate a range of dates around the reference date.
Function (DateVar d, StringVar condition)
//lower case condition condition := LCase (condition);
//'elminate spaces condition := Replace (condition, " ", "");
//'eliminate tabs condition := Replace (condition, " ", "");
Select condition
Case LCase("Aged0To30Days"): (d - 30) To d
Case LCase("Aged31To60Days"): (d - 60) To (d - 31)
Case LCase("Aged61To90Days"): (d - 90) To (d - 61)
Case LCase("AllDatesFromToday"): Is >= d
Case LCase("AllDatesFromTomorrow"): Is >= (d + 1)
Case LCase("AllDatesToToday"): Is <= d
Case LCase("AllDatesToYesterday"): Is <= (d - 1)
Case LCase("Calender1stHalf"): CDate(Year(d), 1, 1) To CDate(Year(d), 6, 30)
Case LCase("Calendar2ndHalf"): CDate(Year(d), 7, 1) To CDate(Year(d), 12, 31)
Case LCase("Calendar1stQtr"), LCase("Calendar1stQuarter"): CDate(Year(d), 1, 1) To CDate(Year(d), 3, 31)
Case LCase("Calendar2ndQtr"), LCase("Calendar2ndQuarter"): CDate(Year(d), 4, 1) To CDate(Year(d), 6, 30)
Case LCase("Calendar3rdQtr"), LCase("Calendar3rdQuarter"): CDate(Year(d), 7, 1) To CDate(Year(d), 9, 30)
Case LCase("Calendar4thQtr"), LCase("Calendar4thQuarter"): CDate(Year(d), 10, 1) To CDate(Year(d), 12, 31)
Case LCase("Last4WeeksToSun"), LCase("Last4WeeksToSunday"): (d - 27 - (WeekDay(d) - 1)) To (d - (Weekday(d) - 1))
Case LCase("Last7Days"): (d - 6) To d
Case LCase("LastFullMonth"): DateSerial(Year(d), Month(d) - 1, 1) To DateSerial(Year(d), Month(d), 1 - 1)
Case LCase("LastFullWeek"): (d - 6 - WeekDay(d)) To (d - WeekDay(d))
Case LCase("LastYearMTD"), LCase("LastYearMonthToDate"): CDate(Year(d) - 1, Month(d), 1) To CDate(DateAdd("yyyy", -1, d))
Case LCase("LastYearYTD"), LCase("LastYearYearToDate"): CDate(Year(d) - 1, 1, 1) To CDate(DateAdd("yyyy", -1, d))
Case LCase("MonthToDate"): CDate(Year(d), Month(d), 1) To d
Case LCase("Next30Days"): d To (d + 30)
Case LCase("Next31To60Days"): (d + 31) To (d + 60)
Case LCase("Next61To90Days"): (d + 61) To (d + 90)
Case LCase("Next91To365Days"): (d + 91) To (d + 365)
Case LCase("Over90Days"): Is <= (d - 91)
Case LCase("WeekToDateFromSun"), LCase("WeekToDateFromSunday"): (d- (Weekday(d) - 1)) To d
Case LCase("YearToDate"): CDate(Year(d), 1, 1) To d
Default: //provide default handling and specify a valid range CDate(1899, 12, 30) To CDate(1899, 12, 30);
